revision.definition_yaml:
name: 写稿审稿发表协作
metadata:
  description: 写稿、审稿、不通过重写、发表的自定义协作工作流
  labels:
    category: content
participants:
  writer:
    display_name: 写稿
    description: 负责起草和修订稿件
    required: true
  reviewer:
    display_name: 审稿
    description: 负责审核稿件质量并给出修改意见
    required: true
  publisher:
    display_name: 发表
    description: 负责最终发表通过审核的稿件
    required: true
runtime:
  kind: state_machine
  state_machine:
    version: 2
    graph_mode: hierarchical
    projection:
      default_visibility: shared
    defaults:
      node_timeout_ms: 120000
      max_attempts: 2
    nodes:
      review_loop:
        kind: loop
        display_name: 写稿审稿循环
        loop:
          mode: fixed
          max_iterations: 3
          entry_node: writing
          result_node: review
          continue_outcomes: [complete]
          break_outcomes: []
          exhausted_outcome: exhausted
          nodes:
            writing:
              kind: bot_task
              display_name: 写稿
              assignee:
                type: bot_binding
                binding: writer
              instruction: |
                根据上游输入或上一轮审稿意见撰写或修订稿件，输出完整稿件文本。
              transitions:
                complete:
                  targets:
                    - review
            review:
              kind: bot_task
              display_name: 审稿
              assignee:
                type: bot_binding
                binding: reviewer
              instruction: |
                审核稿件质量，给出具体修改意见和评分。如果稿件质量达标，明确说明"建议通过"。
        transitions:
          exhausted:
            display_name: 审稿轮次结束
            targets: [publish]
      publish:
        kind: bot_task
        display_name: 发表
        assignee:
          type: bot_binding
          binding: publisher
        instruction: |
          将最终稿件发表，输出发表结果。
        final_output: true
revision.title: 写稿审稿发表协作
